$comment: THE UNIVERSAL HALF. Tiers, the state matrix, and the finite registry of design QUESTIONS with their perceptual channel, scope hint and the CSS custom property each maps to (null = structural, cannot be a token). component-anatomy.json holds only per-component facts. Split 2026-07-27 (U1): both used to live in one blob, so adding a component re-authored the universal half too, which is why there were only three. Resolve the two with scripts/generation/anatomy.mjs. Each question also carries `evidence_any`: keywords that, if found in a component's source evidence, make that question LIKELY relevant to it. Heuristic and openly so — it ranks, it never filters silently (U2).

meta.naming: Parts use parent-prepended names (C1 §3.5): CardTitle, not a bare Title. States are never variants (C1 §3.4).

primitive.definition: one interactive/display concern, nothing named nested inside, repeats many times (Button, Badge, Avatar). C1 §3.1
primitive.render_surface: the component rendered across its REQUIRED STATES, pinned open side by side — so the axis is judged where it lives, not in a collapsed state. A primitive round shows e.g. rest/hover/focus-visible/active/disabled in one strip.

composite.definition: assembles >=2 primitives and OWNS the state orchestration between them, repeats several times (Card, Dialog, Tabs, Toast). C1 §3.1
composite.min_anatomy: root + (trigger if not always-visible) + content region + an explicit dismiss-or-commit affordance
composite.render_surface: 1-3 real instances at real content density, with the required states of the orchestrating part pinned open (e.g. one card shown in its hover-revealed state).

surface.definition: a page-level layout region, usually once per screen (App-shell, Page-header, Empty-state). C1 §3.1
surface.render_surface: rendered once at real density. Do NOT render a whole surface to decide a primitive/composite question — that is a rung error (order of magnitude more cost, and it hides the axis if it lives in a collapsed region).

state_matrix.$comment: B2 §3.1: the whole matrix, not three states. C1 only says WHICH apply per tier (rule 11); B2 owns what each looks like. Every state carrying meaning also changes a NON-colour channel (B2 §3.2, = floor-not-colour-alone).

always.hover: pointer over (never fires on touch/keyboard) — hover is polish, never the only affordance (B2 §3.5)
always.focus-visible: keyboard focus landed — ring >=2px, >=3:1, via outline+outline-offset (B2 §3.13, A5)
always.disabled: removed from tab order + a11y tree, exempt from contrast (B2 §3.10). NOT the same as read-only

conditional.loading: add when the component is asynchronous — skeleton/spinner by the timing ladder (B2 §3.6-3.7)
conditional.error: add when it has a validity concept — aria-invalid + aria-describedby (B2 §3.3)
conditional.selected: add when it is selectable — aria-selected/aria-current
conditional.read-only: add when the value is shown-but-not-editable; stays focusable + announced (B2 §3.10)

corner-radius.hint: 0 sharp (data/tech voice) .. 8 friendly .. 20 soft (A4 rule 116); pick a tight OR a loose, not three

elevation.hint: flat hairline vs dual-layer tinted shadow (A4 120-121); on dark prefer +lightness over shadow

media-aspect.hint: 2:3 poster vs 16:9 still; object-fit:cover, never fill (D2 157)

title-placement.hint: overlaid-on-media vs below-media vs hover-revealed footer

meta-density.hint: 0/1/2 meta lines; tabular-nums for any rating/year (C3 160)

actions-reveal.hint: always-visible vs hover-reveal; a hover-revealed CONTROL needs :focus-within (adv-hover-control-focus-within, B2 3.5)

accent-usage.hint: content-derived accent on <= a few surfaces (border/badge/CTA), neutral elsewhere; 60/30/10 (A1 62)

badge-style.hint: pill vs corner-ribbon vs none; status via a second channel, not colour alone (B2 3.2)

hover-motion.hint: lift (translateY) vs scale vs none; transform+opacity only, 250-300ms standard (B1 70,74)

selected-signal.hint: how 'selected' reads — ring vs fill vs check; a non-colour channel required

emphasis-scale.hint: how primary/secondary/tertiary/ghost differ — a variant enum, mutually exclusive (C1 §3.2)

hover-delta.hint: direction-aware lightness move (A1 67), not a hardcoded second hex; 100-150ms micro (B1 70)

icon-affordance.hint: leading/trailing/none; icon-only needs aria-label (C1 §3.12); one icon set (D2 145)

loading-treatment.hint: spinner vs label-swap; aria-busy; keep width stable (no jitter)

separation.hint: hairline 1px ~8-12% opacity (safer default) vs zebra (unproven, C3 165)

hover-highlight.hint: translucent state layer so it inverts in dark (B2 3.14)

select-affordance.hint: checkbox vs whole-row click; aria-selected; a non-colour selected signal
